newsitem.title: FRANCE: Skip washing powder to launch CD-Rom on laundry.
newsitem.headline: Skip washing powder to launch CD-Rom on laundry.

text.p: Skip, a washing powder made by a French subsidiary of Anglo-Dutch giant Unilever NV/Plc , plans to launch a CD-Rom next month covering everything you need to know about laundry.

Press agency Euro RSCG Vitesse said on Wednesday it had invited journalists to a cyber-cafe here on May 22 to launch the CD-Rom, which it says is the first to be created by a washing powder brand in France.

Euro RSCG Vitesse declined to give more information about the CD's contents ahead of the launch. The laundry CD-Rom is another sign of companies using multimedia to challenge conventional forms of advertising.
